source_policy: 原弓有效射程/梅平打武功射程及基础攻击/神女减益施展距离职责保留；精确米数/攻击加量/上限/快照行为为项目采用，不声称官方系数。

bow_effective_range.unsupported: melee-only tagged attack cannot be made ranged by this source

negative_status_cast_range.scope: explicit Dongling negative status skill cast targeting only

application: require own class learned/allocated positive effective grade and exact skill tags; effective cast/normal reach=explicit base reach+grade100mm, current grade0..40. Same-family range sources strongest contribution only; max+4000mm. Sum/overflow validated, no absent base range default.
targeting: current effective range used for selectable intent and LOS precheck; only valid hostile/party policy target, never global lock or distant interaction. Action snapshots effective range at accept; later source/anti changes apply next action, not retroactive refund.
projectiles: preserve speed/radius/trajectory/solid collision; effective maximum travel distance from accepted reach, lifetime=ceil(distance_mm*60/speed_mm_per_second). Recompute once from explicit positive speed, not keep original short life or extend old flying projectile after gear change. First hostile interception never rewrites primary.
geometry: no through-wall/closed gate/water navigation changes. Max targets, cone/line width and secondary splash/spread/burst radius unchanged unless distinct explicit source says otherwise. Root target original geometry revalidated at hit.
not_gather_or_dodge: does not alter2mcollect,2.5mNPC,3mdodge,portal activation or melee collision capsules. No extra arrow/extra skill proc/AI detection range by this source.
mei_attack: add both endpoints once in the declared base flat source stage; do not additionally multiply shot damage or repeat bonus per arrow snapshot. Not ordinary archer or all weapon-class buff.
persistence: store accepted action/projectile reach and remaining lifetime, no permanent derived range cache. Offline/pause freezes projectile steps; queued derived arrows use accepted root snapshot. Live selector after load recalculates from current legitimate build.
